question: What characterizes a person who merely seeks indulgence in relation to Kula scripture?
premises: Such a person is a seeker driven by greed.
Such a person is always fickle.
Such a person becomes a mockery of Kula scripture.
inference: One who seeks out of greed and remains fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
